_about: v2.2 Neutral rework, unit N1 — the REVIEWED expectations for the cards this unit changes, grounded in docs/v2.2-neutral-design-spec.md §2. The frozen legacy fixtures (tools/v2.2-catalog/parity/legacy-*.json) are never edited; the catalog harness compares the current game to them with exactly these differences allowed and named. Anything else that differs still fails.
fieldsNote: The only PlayerStats fields N1 changes the values of. Swift adds its rungs to moveSpeedMultiplier (deltas 0.08, 0.12, 0.15); Magnetic Core adds its rungs to pickupRadiusMultiplier (0.15, 0.15, 0.20) and SETS magneticCoreSpeedBoost to the tier's total (0.10, 0.20, 0.30). Keen Eye's +0.20 to pickupRadiusMultiplier is gone with the card.
expectedDeltasNote: Per tier, from any starting state in which the card itself has not been taken (its own steps are excluded when the harness builds a state): the value before → after. Floating-point sums as Swift's additive rungs produce them.

neutral_1.name: Swift
neutral_1.detail: Permanent movement speed: +8%, then +20%, then +35% (totals). Adds to your other movement bonuses.

v13_magnetic_core.name: Magnetic Core
v13_magnetic_core.description: +15% XP pull; XP gives a speed burst
v13_magnetic_core.detail: XP orbs are pulled from 15% / 30% / 50% farther (totals). Each XP orb collected grants +10% / +20% / +30% movement speed for 1.5s; another pickup refreshes the time, never the strength. Health orbs are never magnetized.

retiredNotes.neutral_2: v2.2 N1 Neutral (Keen Eye, merged into Magnetic Core)
